# pvecli vm firewall

Manage the firewall of a VM.

## status

Show whether the firewall is enforced here, and why not.

```text
pvecli vm firewall status [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | VM ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## enable

Turn the firewall of a VM on.

```text
pvecli vm firewall enable [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | VM ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--nics` | Also set firewall=1 on every card of the guest (a running guest loses its network briefly). |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## disable

Turn the firewall of a VM off.

```text
pvecli vm firewall disable [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | VM ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## set

Change firewall options: policies, log levels, filters.

```text
pvecli vm firewall set [TARGET] [SETTINGS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | VM ID. |
| `SETTINGS` | KEY=VALUE pairs, as `options` names them. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `--clear VALUE` | Options back to their default, comma separated. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Do not ask for confirmation. |

## options

Show the firewall options, with the defaults Proxmox applies.

```text
pvecli vm firewall options [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | VM ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |

## rule

Firewall rules of a VM

```text
pvecli vm firewall rule
```

## ipset

IP sets of a VM

```text
pvecli vm firewall ipset
```

## alias

Aliases of a VM

```text
pvecli vm firewall alias
```

## log

Show the last lines of the firewall log.

```text
pvecli vm firewall log [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | VM ID. |

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `--since N` |  | Only lines after this UNIX time. |
| `-l`, `--limit N` | `50` | Number of lines. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |
| `-js`, `--json` |  | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
